WITH file_lines AS (
  SELECT file_id, line_count
  FROM code.files
  WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%'
    AND file_id LIKE '%.py'
),
folder_paths AS (
  SELECT
    file_id,
    CASE
      WHEN file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' THEN SPLIT_PART(SUBSTRING(file_id, 18), '/', 1)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS folder_path
  FROM file_lines
),
folder_totals AS (
  SELECT
    folder_path,
    SUM(line_count) AS total_lines
  FROM folder_paths
  JOIN file_lines USING (file_id)
  GROUP BY folder_path
)
SELECT folder_path, total_lines
FROM folder_totals
WHERE total_lines > 1000
ORDER BY total_lines DESC;

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
explanation: The query first isolates .py files under auto_ontology/server/, extracts the immediate subfolder name using SPLIT_PART on the path after the fixed prefix, then sums line counts per folder and filters to those exceeding 1,000 lines.
sql:
WITH file_lines AS (
  SELECT file_id, line_count
  FROM code.files
  WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%'
    AND file_id LIKE '%.py'
),
folder_paths AS (
  SELECT
    file_id,
    CASE
      WHEN file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' THEN SPLIT_PART(SUBSTRING(file_id, 18), '/', 1)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS folder_path
  FROM file_lines
),
folder_totals AS (
  SELECT
    folder_path,
    SUM(line_count) AS total_lines
  FROM folder_paths
  JOIN file_lines USING (file_id)
  GROUP BY folder_path
)
SELECT folder_path, total_lines
FROM folder_totals
WHERE total_lines > 1000
ORDER BY total_lines DESC;
